name: Misono Henrietta Rosenberg
original_name: 御園・アンリエッタ・ローゼンバーグ
source: A prideful girl from Germany. Although she is half-Japanese, she doesn't like to be called "half", and prefers the term "double".
translation: A prideful girl from Germany. Although she is half-Japanese, she doesn't like to be called "half", and prefers the term "double".
